title: 25OBDG07A Part 2 — 2025 Engine and Transmission Diagnostic Parameters
documentScope: 2025 GM diagnostic parameter file 25OBDG07A Part 2. Exact model/engine applicability requires the separate official 2025 file matrix and the document section. No per-code vehicle or engine applicability has been verified.
scopeVerification: document-level only; no vehicle/engine/calibration assignment per code
pageNumbering: 1-based physical PDF page index, not printed footer page labels
rightsStatus: Publicly accessible; commercial bulk republication/adaptation permission has not been verified. Access does not establish a reuse licence.
extractionMethod: pdftotext -layout; regex \b[PBCU][0-3][0-9A-F]{3}\b per physical page; includes references, prerequisite/disabling lists, and monitor tables.
makeScopeEvidence: Publisher is General Motors. No per-code make applicability has been verified; do not infer make applicability from corporate ownership.
scopeCaveat: The application matrix prints 25OBDG047A Part 2.pdf while the official download index uses 25OBDG07A Part 2.pdf. This filename discrepancy is unresolved; no make/model mapping is inferred.
